name: The 2 A.M. Confabulation
mood: late, overconfident, generating fluently and slightly wrong
why: Dark fries and cold curds are the two things the board warns you about, so this is the tray that sounds like a very confident answer that is subtly not true. The demi and the brown toppings are the part that actually works.
next_time: Fresh curds. The cold ones never melted and I noticed the whole way through.
verdicts: Tray holds. It will survive the walk back to the car.
Curds went quiet under the gravy — still good, just no longer talking.
Dark fry, double-fried: heroic if it works, bitter if it doesn't.
Cold curds do not melt — they sit there, dignified and slightly stubborn.
